description: A dashboard to visualize application's deployment.

panels.description: % successful HTTP requests. Only services emitting http_status_code shown.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup", rems_service=~"$service", rems_environment="$env", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", http_status_code=~"^2.*|^3.*"}[5m])) / sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup", rems_service=~"$service", rems_environment="$env", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", http_status_code!=""}[5m]))

panels.title: Availability

targets.expr: sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup", rems_service=~"$service", rems_environment="$env", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER"}[5m]))

100 * sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup", rems_service=~"$service", rems_environment="$env", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", http_status_code=~"^4.*|^5.*"}[5m])) / sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup", rems_service=~"$service", rems_environment="$env", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", http_status_code!=""}[5m]))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by(le) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup", rems_service=~"$service", rems_environment="$env", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER"}[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup", rems_service=~"$service", rems_environment="$env", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER"}[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by(le) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup", rems_service=~"$service", rems_environment="$env", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER"}[5m])))

panels.description: Requests/sec per service. Shows traffic split across APIs.

targets.expr: sum by(rems_service) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup", rems_service=~"$service", rems_environment="$env", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER"}[5m]))

panels.title: Request Rate by Service

targets.expr: sum by(rems_service) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup", rems_service=~"$service", rems_environment="$env", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", http_status_code=~"^4.*|^5.*"}[5m])) / sum by(rems_service) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup", rems_service=~"$service", rems_environment="$env", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER"}[5m]))

panels.description: Response time percentiles. P99 = worst case user experience.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by(le) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup", rems_service=~"$service", rems_environment="$env", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER"}[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup", rems_service=~"$service", rems_environment="$env", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER"}[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by(le) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup", rems_service=~"$service", rems_environment="$env", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER"}[5m])))

panels.title: Latency Percentiles - P50 / P95 / P99

panels.description: Success (2xx/3xx) vs Error (4xx/5xx) rate over time.

targets.expr: sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup", rems_service=~"$service", rems_environment="$env", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", http_status_code=~"^2.*|^3.*"}[5m])) / sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup", rems_service=~"$service", rems_environment="$env", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER"}[5m]))

sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup", rems_service=~"$service", rems_environment="$env", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", http_status_code=~"^4.*|^5.*"}[5m])) / sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup", rems_service=~"$service", rems_environment="$env", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER"}[5m]))

panels.title: Success vs Error Rate

targets.expr: sum by(http_route) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup", rems_service=~"$service", rems_environment="$env", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", http_route!=""}[5m]))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by(http_route, le) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup", rems_service=~"$service", rems_environment="$env", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", http_route!=""}[5m])))

sum by(http_route) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup", rems_service=~"$service", rems_environment="$env", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", http_route!="", http_status_code=~"^4.*|^5.*"}[5m])) / sum by(http_route) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup", rems_service=~"$service", rems_environment="$env", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", http_route!=""}[5m]))

topk(10, sum by(http_route) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_sum{rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup", rems_service=~"$service", rems_environment="$env", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", http_route!=""}[5m])) / sum by(http_route) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup", rems_service=~"$service", rems_environment="$env", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", http_route!=""}[5m])))
sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor",cluster="$cluster", image!="",container!="",container=~"$container",pod=~"^$service-$env-.*$"}[5m])) by (pod, container)
